source_instruction: i am looking for resealable snak club antioxidant trail mix. 5.5oz packs of six.
query: I stopped at the little community park on my walk over to the store today, and there were a group of tiny kids chasing a flock of very dramatic geese right by the pond. One of the kids tripped over a clump of dandelions and landed soft in the grass, and instead of crying they just held up a fistful of fluffy dandelion heads and started blowing seeds as hard as they could, like the fall was totally intentional. The geese all honked like they were personally offended and waddled straight into the water, and a couple of the other parents standing nearby laughed so hard they had to set their iced coffee cups down on the nearest picnic table to keep from spilling. I’m over in the dried fruits and raisins section right now. I’ve heard the options that come in a resealable bag are the regular single pack that’s the standard weight for this aisle, and that those don’t run crazy overpriced so they don’t end up costing too much.

ambiguous.surface: the regular single pack that’s the standard weight for this aisle
